announcements.summary: Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Update on Second Phase of Acquisition
Dreamfolks Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange that basis the recommendation of Audit Committee, the Board of Directors of the Company approved the appointment of TRC Corporate Consulting Private Limited as Internal Auditor of the Company for the Financial Year 2026-27.

Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding appointment of Ms. Meena Lall (DIN: 05133322) as an Additional Director of the Company and designated her as Independent Director of Company, w.e.f. January 01, 2027, to hold office for a term of three (3) consecutive years, commencing from the date of her appointment i.e. January 01, 2027  through December 31, 2029 (both days inclusive), not liable to retire by rotation, subject to the approval of the Shareholders and appointment of Mr. Sanyam Nagpal (DIN: 10074641) as an Additional Director and designated him as Executive Director of Company, w.e.f. January 01, 2027, to hold office for a term of five (5) consecutive years, commencing from the date of his appointment i.e. January 01, 2027 through December 31, 2031 (both days inclusive), liable to retire by rotation, on the terms and conditions of the said appointment, including but not limited to remuneration payable, subject to the approval of the Shareholders.

announcements.summary: Board of Director of Dreamfolks Services Limited has approved the proposal to provide security by way of fixed deposits of INR 5.5  crore each to ICICI Bank Limited and AU Small Finance Bank Limited, to secure the obligations of Ten 11 Hospitality Private Limited (formerly known as  Ten 11 Hospitality LLP ) ( Ten 11 ), subsidiary of the Company, in connection with overdraft facilities backed by Fixed Deposits to be availed by Ten 11, as per the facility documents.
Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Ms Meena Lall as Non- Executive Independent Director of the Company w.e.f. January 01, 2027.
Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Sanyam Nagpal as Executive Director of the Company w.e.f. January 01, 2027.

Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording  of the Earnings Conference Call held on Tuesday, November 03, 2026 at 17:30 hours (IST) pertaining to financial performance of the Company for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
Dreamfolks Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication w.r.t. Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
